description_en: Queries the attack overview of a website, such as the peak HTTP and HTTPS traffic
description_zh: 查询网站业务攻击总览，包括HTTP攻击峰值、HTTPS攻击峰值
name: DescribeDomainOverview

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you leave this parameter unspecified, the current system time is used as the end time.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。不设置该参数表示使用当前时间作为查询结束时间。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website that you want to query. If you leave this parameter unspecified, the statistics on all domain names are queried.

The domain name must be added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all the domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网站业务的域名。不设置该参数表示查询所有域名的数据。

域名必须已接入DDoS高防进行防护。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防的域名
parameters.name: domain

MaxHttp.description_en: The peak queries per second (QPS) during HTTP traffic scrubbing. Unit: QPS

MaxHttps.description_en: The peak QPS during HTTPS traffic scrubbing. Unit: QPS

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
